recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered collage featuring a central hand grenade silhouette overlaid with a rectangular comic-style vignette, set against a chaotic, spray-painted background of dripping textures and vibrant primary colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical grenade anchor vs. horizontal inset vignette
Aggressive military iconography vs. soft human interaction in the inset
Dripping, organic background vs. sharp, black-outlined foreground elements
Triadic color scheme of yellow, red, and purple creating high visual tension
coreInvariants: Heavy black ink outlines on all foreground subjects
Dripping spray paint texture in the background
Flat, saturated color fills without gradients

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large hand grenade occupies the central vertical axis, scaled to nearly the full height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rectangular vignette in the center of the grenade acts as the primary focal point due to its contrasting subject matter.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the grenade's pin, move down to the central vignette, then follow the text on the right before settling on the textured background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'loud' with texture filling every corner.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow and Red provide a high-energy, warning-sign background palette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Purple and Black provide structural definition and shadow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and Olive Green within the central vignette create a distinct sub-environment.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation with high-value contrast between the yellow background and black outlines.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight slab serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Slightly italicized or slanted to the right
Heavy black drop shadow or thick outline for legibility
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned letters to create a block-like appearance
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface to maintain focus on the complex imagery.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, heavy, 70s-influenced pop aesthetic.
Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast screen-print style image. Background is a messy mix of yellow and red spray paint with blue splatters. Center a large black-outlined grenade. In the middle of the grenade, place a horizontal rectangular comic-style panel showing a magenta-colored figure in a close-up embrace.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase text in a heavy, rounded slab-serif font. Color the text yellow with a thick black outline. Position it on the right side, overlapping the grenade's handle.

verificationChecks: Does the central vignette have a distinct color palette from the background?
Is the text legible against the busy background?
Are the black outlines thick and consistent?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features in the vignette
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or AI-hallucinated
Check that the grenade silhouette is recognizable
Verify the 'dripping' effect looks like paint, not digital noise
Confirm the color palette remains within the triadic constraints
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Iconic Object Silhouette] + [Comic Vignette Inset] + [Spray Paint Background] + [Heavy Slab Serif Typography] using a [Triadic High-Contrast Palette].
